steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Space Age began with Sputnik 1 (1957), the first artificial satellite

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Apollo programme (1969–1972) landed 12 humans on the Moon; Apollo 11 was the first

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The International Space Station (ISS) has been continuously occupied since 2000

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Voyager 1 and 2 (launched 1977) are the most distant human-made objects, now in interstellar space

steps.title: Try it yourself

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Know key milestones: Sputnik 1 (1957), Apollo 11 (1969), ISS (2000+) Voyager 1 is in interstellar space — this is often tested Both boards cover the history and purpose of space exploration Be able to discuss the benefits AND risks of space exploration
